coreMemory.english: v. to discover, locate, or form an opinion after experience
coreMemory.structure: find the answer /ˈfaɪnd ðə ˈænsɚ/（找到答案）；find out about something /ˈfaɪnd ˈaʊt əˈbaʊt ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（查明；了解某事）；find it difficult to do something /ˈfaɪnd ˈɪt ˈdɪfəkəlt ˈtuː ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（发现做某事很难）；find a way to do something /ˈfaɪnd ə ˈweɪ ˈtuː ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（找到做某事的方法）

coreMemory.commonError: ❌ can to find → ✅ can find；❌ to finding → ✅ to find

commonErrors.note: 情态动词 can 后直接接动词原形，不加 to。
不定式 to 后接动词原形；不要把不定式和 -ing 形式混合。
